description.en: Shows the Fighting Spirit evolution presentation (jingle J_07, message "sysmes-Avatar-00002") without changing anything. No shipped script calls it.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".
true to lock the character's Fighting Spirit afterwards (CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG(hdl, true)); otherwise the lock state it had before is kept.

examples.case: Announcing an evolution already applied (not found in script_clean/; invented)
